hints.title: Temporal Ordering
hints.text: Sort events primarily by their starting times.

hints.title: Suffix Maximum Array
hints.text: Precompute suffix maximum values for the largest event value reachable from each suffix.

hints.title: Complement Search
hints.text: For each event, find the first subsequent event starting strictly after its conclusion.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect

class Solution:
    def maxTwoEvents(self, events: list[list[int]]) -> int:
        events.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
        n = len(events)
        suffix_max = [0] * (n + 1)
        for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
            suffix_max[i] = max(suffix_max[i + 1], events[i][2])

        starts = [e[0] for e in events]
        ans = 0

        for s, e, val in events:
            idx = bisect.bisect_right(starts, e)
            ans = max(ans, val + suffix_max[idx])

        return ans
```

complexity.time: O(N log N) sorting events and searching suffix max
complexity.notes: Combines at most two non-overlapping intervals to maximize total value.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of non-overlapping events takes O(N^2) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputed suffix maximums enable O(log N) lookup per event.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle both one-event and two-event options cleanly.
